column1: # family_overrides.tsv -- ResFinder gene name -> family key, for the cases the rules in
# gene_regex is matched against the WHOLE gene name (the ResFinder template name up to
# `_<variant>_<accession>`). First matching row wins, and every row here beats the rules.
# Family keys are the ones gene_host_context.tsv is keyed on, so a
# family named here is one the intrinsic/acquired table can answer for.

# Serratia); plasmid fosA3/fosA4/... stay their own families rather than inheriting fosA's
